entries.en: Just open the door.
How would I fix that?
When emergency protocols were implemented within the hot labs, the cabling was automatically ejected.
The valves to the helium-3 fuel line must be opened. This can be done at the controls on the reactor assembly proper.
The landlines are designed for easy reconnection.
The router for the landlines is on the roof of Operations. Simply activate the controls, and the hardware will reconnect and reboot automatically.
The chamber is equipped with failsafe system which vents a 5000-degree Kelvin plasma. This is sufficient to sterilize any potential contagion.
Where's Benezia?
A backup power system, Shepard. Must be for the station mainframe.
A backup power system, Commander. It must be for the station's mainframe.
Shepard, that is a backup power system for the station mainframe.
A backup power system, Commander. Must be for the station mainframe.
So whack it and turn this thing on.
Can we fix it? Get this place back online?
We could probably get it back online.
The damage is not extensive. It could be repaired.
It should be easy to fix it.
Critical startup error. Virtual Intelligence user interface offline. Manual boot required.
Now entering main reactor.
All systems functioning within accepted tolerances.
The He3 fuel line's cut.
The He3 fuel line is cut.
Now exiting to the roof.
Inter-facility communications functioning normally.
...control grou-- ...loose in the... they're... can't escape... up the tunnels now. We're sorry. The leads couldn't get to... --struct. ..out while you can...
He killed himself because he was part of whatever happened here?
Damned shame. God only gives you one life.
Many salarians believe in a "wheel of life." Your people call it "reincarnation." My people have a similar philosophy.
He might disagree. Many salarians believe in a "wheel of life." I believe your people call it "reincarnation."
He must have felt there was no hope of surviving. That killing himself would be easier.
There must have been something he could do to help his comrades.
Among my people, a suicide's body would be left for scavengers. The nathak will get to him eventually.
He killed himself. Because he was part of whatever happened here.
They're locked in.
They are locked in.
I could bypass the door. It looks like the trams to the subsidiary stations are beyond it.
The door could be finessed. It appears that the trams to the subsidiary stations are beyond it.
We could hot-wire the door. Looks like the trams to the subsidiary stations are beyond it.
It seems the trams to the subsidiary stations are beyond this. That door could be finessed.
That door could be finessed. Looks like the trams to the subsidiary stations are beyond it.
Now arriving at Peak 15 Central Station.
Departing Central Station. Destination: Rift Station.
Now arriving at Rift Station, Binary Helix research facility.
Departing Rift Station. Destination: Central Station.
Now entering decontamination and transit hub.
User alert! Loose contaminants in the decontamination chamber. Access to passenger tramways inadvisable.
No hazardous or unauthorized materials detected.
Maybe those scientists can make us some kinda--I don't know--anti-bug plague. Or something.
I'd kill for a P204. Just hold down the trigger and fzzzzap! Hallway full of flash-boiled bugs.
Cap'n tell you about the hot labs? I wouldn't go there. Bug central.
Didn't think I'd see this kind of action after retirement.
Sure could use some grenades right now.
You should talk to the cap'n.
Get inside already. I wouldn't be out here if I didn't have to be.
Something you need?
The facility's off the network. The only way to find out would be to send scouts down the elevator. I won't send my people to their death.
Since Mira's back online, I had a look at your record.
I hope you didn't use up all that luck on Akuze.
I didn't expect to meet a Star of Terra recipient. What's a Skyllian hero doing up here?
No, thanks. It might jam on the ego.
